en.t: Just then the Governor of Kii arrived.

units.source_text: 他又加了灯笼，剔亮了灯烛，摆出些点心来。

en.t: He added more lanterns, trimmed the lamps and candles brighter, and set out some refreshments.

units.source_text: 源氏公子引用催马乐，搭讪着说：“你家‘翠幕张’好了么？

en.t: Prince Genji quoted a saibara song and, making light conversation, said, "Is the 'green curtain' of your house ready?

units.source_text: 倘招待得不周到，你这主人没面子呢！”

en.t: If the hospitality is lacking, you, as the host, will lose face!"

units.source_text: 纪伊守笑道：“真是‘肴馔何所有？

en.t: The Governor of Kii laughed and said, "It is truly a case of, 'What delicacies can we possibly offer?
This matter takes some hard thought' [[27]](#part1331.html#m27)."

units.source_text: 源氏公子就在一旁歇息。

en.t: Prince Genji rested there at the side.
The attendants, too, had all fallen quietly asleep.
